name: @emsenn/organizing-a-knowledge-vault
description: Organizing a knowledge vault: the @emsenn/organizing downstream specialization that admits this repo's content/ filepath trees as knowledge-vault carriers, then hands the admitted documents to @emsenn/knowing for memory, proof, and research readings.

scripts.check: pnpm run codegen && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm run codegen && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node copy-dist-assets.mjs && chmod +x dist/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run build
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
